acceptance_reviewed: Lone surrogate command responses complete promptly
Valid surrogate pairs and ordinary Unicode are preserved
Malformed frames cannot resolve nested, negative, zero, or absent IDs
Closing external connections terminates transport without closing the browser
Close is bounded, repeated, concurrent, releases pending callers, and rejects later writes
Plain and Rustls transports force TCP EOF
Windows socket duplication and shutdown compile and execute
gaps: No separate Spec review was provided.

provenance.reviewer_model: Anthropic Claude Sonnet and GLM 5.3 Flash Solution Gate reviews plus local protocol substrates

independent_challenge.evidence: Two frozen-checkout cross-family design reviews were challenged by independent Serde and socket probes, then the selected mechanisms were driven against plain WebSocket, Rustls, external manager, and real Chrome substrates.

claim_inventory.location: GitHub issues #1666 and #1726 plus the frozen Solution Gate packet
claim_inventory.evidence: Requirements R0 through R10 were reviewed, including Windows runtime execution through cuse.
The design requires repair then typed retry, structural positive top-level ID fallback, duplicated socket shutdown, bounded idempotent close, and manager ownership preservation.

claim_inventory.location: Existing close and connection behavior exposed through daemon commands
claim_inventory.evidence: No public command, flag, schema, output shape, or documented ownership rule changed; real Chrome close and external manager ownership were exercised.

The reader parser, pending map, write paths, close sequence, inspect handle, underlying plain and Rustls socket access, and BrowserManager integration were reviewed. Commit 8ccd1ee has the same tree b489bbc62ebf9ab7ce9d90a7d4b60742a82b6f1c as the tested commit 5a5ab7c; only the verified SSH signature changed.

Close state: open, close starting, closed, repeated close, concurrent close
Sink state: available and lock held by another task

assumptions.claim: socket2 SockRef::try_clone and shutdown(Both) behave equivalently on Windows.
assumptions.evidence: Microsoft Windows Server 2025 executed the duplicated-socket plain and Rustls shutdown tests; peers observed EOF and all tasks completed.

assumptions.claim: Shutting down duplicated TCP after a best-effort Close frame is acceptable for Rustls teardown.
assumptions.evidence: A local Rustls peer received the Close frame and observed underlying TCP EOF.

assumptions.claim: U+FFFD replacement is acceptable for lone-surrogate CDP payloads.
assumptions.evidence: Both source issue reproductions require a usable response or event, both candidate authors use replacement behavior, and valid pairs plus ordinary Unicode remain unchanged.

assumptions.claim: BrowserManager is the ownership boundary that decides whether Browser.close is allowed.
assumptions.evidence: All daemon CDP teardown reaches BrowserManager::close through close_current_browser, and the existing browser_process ownership gate remains before transport close.

assumptions.claim: Inspect proxy send failures are terminal or best effort and do not require caller rollback.
assumptions.evidence: The forwarding loop breaks on send error, initial attach propagates error, and detach is explicitly best effort.

side_effects.evidence: Transport close sends a best-effort WebSocket Close frame and irreversibly shuts down the TCP connection.

commit_points.effect: The CDP connection enters closed state and no new writes may commit.

failure_partitions.residual_observed: A busy sink cannot extend close past the bound; tasks are aborted and later writes remain rejected.

retry.evidence: Concurrent and repeated close calls complete within two seconds.

failure_partitions.residual_observed: The peer observes EOF and the pending caller receives channel closed; pending length becomes zero.
failure_partitions.cleanup_owner: CdpClient::close with reader cleanup as backstop

retry.evidence: The same CdpClient deliberately remains closed; reconnect creates a new client rather than retrying the closed transport.

failure_partitions.evidence: Pending release, post-close rejection, and live-inspect EOF tests passed.
